# lowering

```go
import "github.com/lucasavila00/tgo/internal/lowering"
```

Package lowering inserts statements into typed Go expressions and lowers error propagation.

The lowerer changes typed Go expressions into statements and result references. Its input is a checked package. Load loads one ordinary Go package; SourceFromPackage accepts a package already loaded by the driver.

Source.InsertAfter inserts callback statements after a selected expression. Source.LowerPropagations replaces recorded propagation calls with typed saved results, error checks, and returns. Both operations return formatted Go files. Changed AST nodes are copied so the typed source can be used again.

For use\(first\(\), target\(\)\!\!, last\(\)\), lowering saves the earlier call before checking target\(\)'s error. An error returns before last\(\) runs. Conditional operands stay in their branches. Assignment lowering keeps the original store object and the required check timing. Each function has its own return target.

Fresh names and explicit checked types preserve source bindings and conversions. See the correctness report for implementation rules and the tests that check them.

## type After

After receives references to the evaluated expression results.

```go
type After func(results []ast.Expr) []ast.Stmt
```

Propagation defines the error action for a typed marker call.

```go
}
```

## type Source

### func Load

```go
func Load(dir, pattern string) (*Source, error)
```

Load reads and type\-checks one Go package selected by pattern in dir. It records expression positions for later statement insertion.

### func SourceFromPackage

```go
func SourceFromPackage(p *packages.Package, dir string) (*Source, error)
```

SourceFromPackage records expression positions and insertion limits in a checked package. File names are relative to dir; a package with type errors returns an error.

### func \(\*Source\) InsertAfter

```go
func (s *Source) InsertAfter(site Site, after After) (map[string][]byte, error)
```

InsertAfter returns Go files with the callback's statements after the selected expression. The callback receives saved results; the original syntax tree stays unchanged.

### func \(\*Source\) LowerPropagations

```go
func (s *Source) LowerPropagations(operations map[string]Propagation) (map[string][]byte, error)
```

LowerPropagations replaces typed marker calls with calls, error checks, and returns. It returns Go file contents and reports an error if a selected operation was not replaced.
